# Apache Arrow decimal regression fixture

`generated_decimal.arrow` is the unchanged Apache Arrow synthetic IPC gold fixture from:
https://github.com/apache/arrow-testing/blob/9ff285c88565f0f6abc855918c6a342e70e4909c/data/arrow-ipc-stream/integration/1.0.0-littleendian/generated_decimal.arrow_file

SHA-256: `f379d35152ec12e4764da9bb11d7cb38902ae0e9f89aabb7f2d69baf00b4b75e`

`generated_decimal.expected.json` extracts f0's validity and unscaled decimal coefficients from the same commit's independent `generated_decimal.json.gz` gold data. This is an expected-data subset; it was not generated by this app's decoder. The fixture has 306 rows, 36 decimal columns and 36 record batches. The browser-reported regression is page 7 with 50 rows/page: ascending f0 must place record 302 (-20.98) before record 303 (-18.20).
